breaking_news.headline: Pro-Trump Influencer Benny Johnson is being sued for defamation by ICE protesters
breaking_news.summary: The lawsuit says the prominent conservative podcaster falsely claimed the protesters were assaulting ICE officers during demonstrations at an ICE facility in Illinois last year.

breaking_news.headline: Economist Betsey Stevenson breaks down the gender gap in recent hiring reports
breaking_news.summary: The U.S. economy added fewer jobs than expected last month and unemployment ticked up to 4.2%. NPR's Scott Simon talks to Betsey Stevenson, an economist at the University of Michigan.

breaking_news.headline: She died covering war for Fox News. Her parents blame the network — and a star reporter
breaking_news.summary: The family members of two Fox News journalists killed while covering the war in Ukraine are suing the network, saying it put getting the story ahead of its people.

breaking_news.headline: G7 countries reluctantly agree to tap their fuel reserves to help the U.S.
breaking_news.summary: G7 nations plan to release large amounts of diesel fuel soon, but European countries were not entirely happy about the agreement.

breaking_news.headline: New Hollywood era begins with an epic mega merger between Paramount and Warner Bros.
breaking_news.summary: The Paramount and Warner Bros. merger has survived court challenges, public protests and regulatory scrutiny. Now, the Hollywood heavyweight, named Skydance, begins operating.

breaking_news.headline: Disney, ABC battle Trump's FCC in court over free speech protections
breaking_news.summary: President Trump has repeatedly called for Disney's ABC to fire late night comedian Jimmy Kimmel, for mocking him. Trump has also routinely denounced ABC's The View, accusing it of being unfair.

breaking_news.headline: As Taiwan expands Arizona chip plant, China warns against developing political ties
breaking_news.summary: The world's biggest chipmaker now manufactures at scale in Phoenix, as well as Taiwan. China is warning political leaders in Arizona to not get too friendly.

breaking_news.headline: What voters in 6 key states could tell us about the 2026 midterms
breaking_news.summary: Morning Edition is heading to Maine, Texas, North Carolina, Georgia, Ohio and Michigan to hear what voters say is shaping their choices ahead of the midterm elections.

breaking_news.headline: Pornhub returns to Australia but only for adults with Apple devices
breaking_news.summary: The world's most popular porn site went dark in March in Australia due to age verification laws.

breaking_news.headline: Tear gas in Paris and Marseille as school protests grow across France
breaking_news.summary: Crowds of mainly teenagers called for more resources for schools and an end to what they called police repression.

breaking_news.headline: Former Australian bishop jailed for sexually abusing young men
breaking_news.summary: The former Bishop of Broome is one of the most senior Catholic clerics in the world to face sex abuse charges.

breaking_news.headline: A beautiful Himalayan bird is changing its voice due to human activity, research shows
breaking_news.summary: A sharp increase in human activity is affecting the way the Himalayan monal lives and communicates, studies show.

breaking_news.headline: Ex-US spy who stashed gold bars in his home admits to $200m scam
breaking_news.summary: David Rush, who also confessed to providing secrets to a foreign government, had revealed the existence of a "clandestine human source", prosecutors said.

breaking_news.headline: What is pneumonic plague and how does it spread?
breaking_news.summary: The death of a worker from a Russian lab that researches plague has prompted questions about the disease.

breaking_news.headline: Residents of kibbutz destroyed in 7 October Hamas-led attacks grapple with how to rebuild
breaking_news.summary: Three years on from the attack on Nir Oz, in which 47 people were killed and 76 taken hostage, some survivors have returned to live there.

breaking_news.headline: US death row inmate Christa Pike awake and speaking after failed execution, lawyers say
breaking_news.summary: Experts and lawyers called the apparent recovery unprecedented, noting she is believed to be the only known person to survive a lethal injection.

breaking_news.headline: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you
breaking_news.summary: The deal is expected to alter the entertainment and news industries but could it mean higher prices for consumers?

breaking_news.headline: Amazon wins global rights to stream Emmys in six-year deal
breaking_news.summary: The gala is leaving traditional US broadcast networks for live worldwide streaming.

breaking_news.headline: What can I do to protect myself after 'Asos hacked' message?
breaking_news.summary: Asos says people should not engage with the unauthorised notification and says it'll provide further information.

breaking_news.headline: Asos confirms hackers sent 'unauthorised' notification to app users
breaking_news.summary: Asos confirmed an "unauthorised customer notification" was sent out via its app on Tuesday, after users raised alarm.
